lines.text: Lantern is over the drop zone. Gideon, your clamps release on my mark.
Mark. Welcome to the Harrow Basin.
Landing. All systems online.
Dry Wash patrol. Four waypoints. Keep your feet under you and your eyes on the ridgelines. Move to Nav Alpha.
Contact. One Sable drone, hovering past Alpha. It's yours, Gideon.
Twist your torso onto it and hold space. Your weapons fire one after another. Lead it if it moves.
Splash one. Clean work.
Move to Nav Bravo.
That hull on your left was Tomas. Nineteen years in the sand. Don't stop to look.
Evasion drill, kid. That drone is loaded with training sabots. Watch for the glow, keep your throttle up, and walk across its line of fire.
A standing mech is a dead mech. Keep those legs moving.
Clean miss.
That's a hit. Don't stand in its sights. Again.
Good. Now put it down.
Nav Charlie. Kestrel has movement in the wash.
Four Sables, dug in along the wash. They've seen us.
Open the tac map with tab. Pick one of us, then pick a drone. We'll take it from there.
Anvil. Engaging.
Kestrel. On it.
Ratchet, moving.
Drone down.
Target down.
Scratch one.
Wash is clear. Good hunting, all of you.
Lantern is inbound for pickup at Nav Delta. Bring it home, Gideon.
That's a patrol. A hundred years, and the Wake still walks. Welcome aboard.
Gideon is down. Get that pilot out of there.
Incoming.
Heat critical.
Armor critical.
Waypoint reached.
